title: the chart door refuses a criterion whose instrument the sealer cannot run
intention: The chart's validate door refuses a criterion whose instrument does not extract to a command the sealer can start, naming the criterion and quoting the instrument. A repo path head counts only when git records it executable (index mode 100755): that is what the sealer's checkout holds, whatever box drafts the chart (outline 9.4.8.1: the instrument runs where the sealer runs).
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: a4892e762b70's standing validate (drafted on Windows) carried 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_declaring_returns_posix_paths.py run with the venv python'. extract_command returned it as runnable because the head path exists, os.access X_OK is False, and the verdict exited 126 and kicked the ticket back into FIXME.
traces_to: Law 1 and Law 8: a criterion that cannot run is found at the door that admits it, not at the verdict after the build; a green is earned by an instrument that ran.
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py, _first_token_runs: a head containing '/' that names a file inside the repo runs only when its git index mode is 100755 (git ls-files -s); a path head outside the repo is judged as today. The same predicate serves both doors, so no box judges by its own filesystem. In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/validate.py, inspect_validate: one record entry 'every_criterion_instrument_runs_on_the_sealer' whose actual lists each criterion whose extract_command is None, with a lack naming it and quoting its instrument. Proof: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/proofs/test_the_chart_refuses_an_instrument_this_box_cannot_run.py, keyed PROVES '477f3b58142e' clauses 1-3.

outcomes.claim: a validate packet whose criterion instrument is 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_declaring_returns_posix_paths.py run with the venv python' is refused, the lack naming the criterion and quoting the instrument, and nothing berths

extract_command returns None for that instrument on any box, because its head's git index mode is 100644, so observe_instruments makes zero runner calls over it; a head at 100755 (bin/cairn) still extracts

the same packet with 'bin/cairn test <proof>' berths, and the existing validate and verdict proofs stay green; test_chart_validate.py's fixture instruments become commands the sealer can start (two prose instruments, and one an apostrophe leaves unsplittable), and its import allowlist admits verdict, the one reader of an instrument

constraints: A head that is a shell construct or a name shutil.which resolves is judged as today.
The verdict door's own refusal of an unrunnable instrument (0d38d0f5a4e3) is unchanged in shape; it now also covers a repo path head git records at 100644.
No door judges a repo path head by the drafting box's filesystem (os.access), because a Windows box reads X_OK true for any file.

measured.saw: extract_command('cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_declaring_returns_posix_paths.py run with the venv python') returned the string; os.access(<proof>, X_OK) False; a4892e762b70's verdict exited 126
measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c over verdict.extract_command on akiendelllinux; slot7.sh walk output

measured.saw: a4a3f5634e7c's verdict ran 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_ticket_whose_build_is_on_main_has_crossed.py' and exited 126, bash: Permission denied; that proof is git mode 100644
measured.how: a4a3f5634e7c's ticket log on akiendelllinux; git ls-files -s
